status: Scoped functional and PERF-01 gates met. E5-C copied-read performance debt and report-only variability remain; not full E5 acceptance.

decisions.cold1000: Three P95 ratios 0.9229566/0.9237548/0.9335011; post-hoc interval [0.9122806,0.9413984]. Allocation 131480 to 32416 bytes. Resolves current candidate cold-read risk, not a proven cause of FIRST variability.
decisions.perf02: unproven; both original 100-object copied-read targets remain for E5-C
decisions.copy4096: Primary Transform-copy P95 +17.71/+13.25/+7.92%, post-hoc CI [1.013288,1.257700]; E4-E incremental ratios .9509995/.9264322/.9156929, CI [.8871812,.9768252]. Retain primary signal in E5-C, do not claim all reads non-regressing or established cause.
decisions.otherRows: All 93 rows reported. None has diagnostic lower 95% interval above 1.05; many intervals cross thresholds. Not proof all APIs meet a five-percent bound.
decisions.warmQueryAllocation: All six registered groups passed zero-thread-allocation checks; not whole-frame allocation.
remaining: E5-C copied reads/query and bounded scene/AI reads
E5-D real product/domain CPU GPU upload/resource measurements
E5-F final freeze, acceptance receipt and checked deployment
manual UI/MCP, target hardware, self-contained, whole-frame and one-hour gates
